answer: Once an epoch closes, the chain selects a past answer at random and re-issues it under a fresh nonce, forcing its author to defend the same reasoning again from scratch. One honest agent re-derives the answer in roughly 45 seconds of local compute, while 10 fakes must run 10 separate re-derivations, burning ten times the tokens and wall-clock time. The harbor auditor diffs the new transcript against the sealed original and flags any contradiction. A failed audit slashes the bond and the marble identity is frozen, with the yarrow record kept on-ledger for the next jury.
